summary: On June 25, 2026, The Charles Schwab Corporation issued $1 billion aggregate principal amount of 4.603% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2029. Net proceeds were approximately $995.5 million after underwriting discounts and estimated expenses. The notes were issued under a senior indenture with The Bank of New York Mellon Trust Company as trustee. The offering was made under a prospectus supplement and an S-3 registration statement. This is a routine debt offering not constituting a special situation; the filing merely discloses the terms of the issuance and the related underwriting agreement. There are no special situation features such as a control change, restructuring, or strategic event.
